title: 第244章 开山第243章 雷池
content_zh:
现实世界。
姜峰睁开双眸，已然从南冥王的魂宫内退了出来。
他眸光淡漠的望着天上的罗酆山，眼底闪过一抹凝重之色。
凭借大道天阙镇压一切的特性，姜峰才得以在这场神魂之战中，取得些许优势。
但这并不能说明，他的神魂之力便强于对方。
眼前的罗酆山，只是那位永恒强者的一道投影。
魂宫的雷霆之龙，也只是这道投影的一部分，所能发挥出来的力量，也不过是道宫境巅峰的层次。
纵然只是如此，却也压得南冥王不得动弹，险些魂飞魄散。
永恒之强，不到那个境界，终究难以企及，难以想象。
但……这也从另一角度说明姜峰的恐怖。
南冥王的意识，此刻也从魂宫之内退了出来，回归肉身。
他看了眼天上的罗酆山，接着又将目光转移到姜峰身上，眼神里多出了些许震惊！
未及永恒，却依旧拥有和永恒掰手腕的能力，这已经无法简单的用言语来形容了。
起码以他的修为和眼界，已经无法判断姜峰目前的实力。
他注视这个少年的背影，一时沉默不语。
【姜黎】的记忆告诉他，这是一个不满二十岁的少年。
他无法想象，一个人该怎么做，才能用二十年的时间，便修行到触及永恒的境界……这实在令人难以置信。
轰轰隆隆——！！！
洪亮的声音，将南冥王的思绪，就此打断。
那雷霆山峰收回了施加在南冥王魂宫内的力量，转而在现实中显露神威。

紫色雷霆如同一块深紫色的帘幕，遮天蔽日，笼罩万里苍穹。
雷霆之威，盖压天地。
密密麻麻的雷霆，犹如暴雨倾盆，铺天盖地的落下来。
“天罚……不赦！！！”
万千雷音交织，形成一道宏大的声音，仿若天威震怒。
雷劫就此降临！
轰轰隆隆的声音，成为世界的唯一。
其声之浩大，如山崩地裂。
其势之磅礴，如瀚海翻涌。
此方天地，就此变成雷之世界。
目光所见，皆为雷霆。
轰得虚空生隙，杀得元炁泯灭。
煌煌天威，犹如灭世！
姜峰身前撑起的火焰屏障，在如此密集，如此恐怖的雷霆轰击下，泛起一阵阵密集的涟漪。
火焰屏障在一瞬间遭遇千万次的冲击，开始摇摇欲坠。
在魂宫内的厮杀，罗酆山并非取得优势，但在现实世界中，姜峰的火焰大道，却依旧无法与对方的雷霆大道相比。
道的境界，终究尚有差距。
content_en:
real world.
Jiang Feng opened his eyes and had already retreated from Nan Pluto's soul palace.
He looked at Luofeng Mountain in the sky with indifferent eyes, a solemn look flashed in his eyes.
Relying on the ability of Dao Tianque to suppress everything, Jiang Feng was able to gain some advantages in this battle of souls.
But this does not mean that his soul power is stronger than the other party's.
The Luofeng Mountain in front of you is just a projection of the eternal powerhouse.
The Thunder Dragon in the Soul Palace is only a part of this projection, and the power it can exert is only at the peak level of the Dao Palace Realm.
Even though it was just like this, it still suppressed Nan Pluto so much that he could not move and almost lost his soul.
The power of eternity is ultimately unattainable and unimaginable unless it reaches that level.
But... this also shows Jiang Feng's terror from another angle.
Nan Pluto's consciousness also retreated from the Soul Palace at this moment and returned to the physical body.
He glanced at Luofeng Mountain in the sky, and then shifted his gaze to Jiang Feng, with a little shock in his eyes!
Less than eternity, but still possessing the ability to compete with eternity, this can no longer be simply described in words.
At least based on his cultivation and vision, he could no longer judge Jiang Feng's current strength.
He stared at the young man's back and remained silent for a moment.
[Jiang Li]'s memory told him that he was a boy under twenty years old.
He couldn't imagine what a person could do to cultivate to the realm of eternity in twenty years... This was really unbelievable.
Boom boom boom——! ! !
The loud voice interrupted Nan Pluto's thoughts.
The Thunder Mountain Peak withdrew the power exerted on Nan Pluto's Soul Palace, and instead showed its power in reality.
The purple thunder is like a deep purple curtain, covering the sky and the sun, covering thousands of miles of sky.
The power of thunder overwhelmed the heaven and earth.
Dense thunderbolts fell overwhelmingly like torrential rain.
"Heaven's punishment... will not be forgiven!!!"
Thousands of thunder sounds intertwined to form a huge sound, like the wrath of God's power.
Thunder disaster is coming!
The rumbling sound became the only one in the world.
The sound was so loud that it was like a mountain collapsing and the earth cracking.
Its momentum is majestic, like the turbulence of the vast ocean.
This world has become a world of thunder.
Everything you see is thunder.
The blast created a gap in the void, killing Yuan Qi until it was wiped out.
The brilliant power of heaven is like destroying the world!
The flame barrier held up in front of Jiang Feng caused dense ripples under the impact of such dense and terrifying thunder.
The flame barrier encountered thousands of impacts in an instant and began to shake.
In the fight in the Soul Palace, Luo Fengshan did not gain an advantage, but in the real world, Jiang Feng's Avenue of Flames was still unable to compare with his opponent's Avenue of Thunder.
There is still a gap in the realm of Tao after all.
